invariants.rationale: The method returns the output of a helper's execute() method, which should not return null in normal operation.
The result is returned as HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>, so its runtime type should conform.
WriteMetadata implementations should provide non-null write status information upon return.
The size of returned write statuses is non-negative by definition.
Partition-to-write-statistics map should be produced as part of a metadata return.
